integrity: Exact proof included; standalone stdlib graph-level checker; self-review only and no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to connected ordinary domination of powers of cycles; no claim for other circulants or connected total domination. Ordinary-cycle r=1 case was known. Residual prior-art risk from alternate enumerative formulations and incomplete indexing. Finite checks corroborate an infinite combinatorial proof.
title: Connected-domination polynomials of cycle powers: the one-long-gap theorem
